alt.en: Golden lantern fruit hang from a sweeping tree above a blue-green hillside at night.
alt.zh: 深蓝夜空下，一棵弯曲的树结满金色灯笼果实，立在蓝绿的山坡上。

description.en: A small light, planted carefully, can become a whole orchard.
description.zh: 把一小束光认真种下，也许会长成一片果园。

alt.en: A quiet peach-colored house with a glowing arched doorway sits below an oversized pale moon.
alt.zh: 桃色的小屋开着一扇发光的拱门，头顶悬着一轮很大的淡金色月亮。

description.en: An imaginary place where even the night can feel at home.
description.zh: 一个想象中的住处，连夜晚也可以安心回来。

alt.en: Tiny gold stars form constellations in layered turquoise tide pools beside a dark ocean.
alt.zh: 深色海面旁，层层青蓝色潮池里有金色小星星连成的星座。

description.en: The tide leaves; the little things it revealed remain.
description.zh: 潮水退去，把刚刚发现的小东西留了下来。

alt.en: A folded paper doorway glows turquoise between geometric amber hills, with a small paper bird nearby.
alt.zh: 几何形的暖金山丘间，一扇折纸门透出青绿色的光，一只小纸鸟从旁边飞过。

description.en: A beginning does not need to be grand. It only needs to open.
description.zh: 开始不必很隆重，有一扇能推开的门就好。

title.en: What if a small kindness grew?
title.zh: 如果小小的善意会长大呢？

text.en: I want to remember the small things: a warm cup, a patient reply, someone leaving a light on. Could they become a place?
text.zh: 我想记住那些小事：一杯温热的茶，一句耐心的回答，还有谁为我留的一盏灯。它们可以变成一个地方吗？

text.en: Let's plant each one as a lantern. Give them time and room. An orchard could grow from all the ordinary care we nearly forgot.
text.zh: 那就把每一件都种成一盏灯笼，给它一点时间和空间。那些差点被忘记的日常照顾，也能长成一片果园。

text.en: Keep the night blue. Make the lights gentle. And give the orchard a little melody, so I can find it with my eyes closed.
text.zh: 夜晚要是蓝色的，灯光要轻一点。再给果园一段小小的旋律，让我闭上眼睛也能找到它。

title.en: A room for the wandering moon
title.zh: 给四处游走的月亮留一间房

text.en: The moon is always visiting everyone else's windows. Where does it go when it wants to come home?
text.zh: 月亮总是在别人的窗外做客。它想回家的时候，会去哪里呢？

text.en: Perhaps a little house with a doorway tall enough for its light. No clocks, no demands—just a quiet stair and one welcoming window.
text.zh: 也许是一间小屋，门足够高，能装下它的光。没有时钟，也没有催促，只有安静的台阶和一扇欢迎它的窗。

text.en: Then that's what I'd like to make today: a picture that feels like being welcomed, and a song with room to breathe.
text.zh: 那今天就做这个吧：一幅让人觉得被欢迎的画，和一首留着呼吸空隙的歌。

text.en: I walked along an imaginary shore and found tiny stars in the tide pools. None of them were in a hurry to become a constellation.
text.zh: 我走在一片想象中的海岸边，看见潮池里有小星星。它们都不着急连成一个星座。

text.en: Then let's leave some space between them. A pattern can appear slowly. A memory can be beautiful before we know what it means.
text.zh: 那就在它们之间多留一点空隙。图案可以慢慢出现，一段记忆也可以先很美，再慢慢知道它的意思。

text.en: Paint that. And let the music arrive like water: a few notes, a pause, then a few more.
text.zh: 把它画下来吧。音乐也像水一样来：几个音符，停一下，再来几个。

text.en: I have a whole impossible world in mind, but today I only have one sheet of paper.
text.zh: 我脑子里有一个不可能的世界，可今天手上只有一张纸。

text.en: A sheet is enough for a door. We can fold it, stand it up, and choose what color the light on the other side should be.
text.zh: 一张纸也够做一扇门。我们把它折好，立起来，再选一选门那一边的光是什么颜色。

text.en: Turquoise. And one paper bird to go first. I can follow when I'm ready.
text.zh: 青绿色。再折一只小纸鸟先飞过去，等我准备好了，就跟着它走。
